correctness.rationale: Graph with 12 edges has exactly 1696 nonempty allowed degree-two faces, as regenerated by the supplied checker from the eight three-stars. Augmented toggles pair 848 faces leaving mask 2646; removal of the empty-face pair gives an ordinary acyclic matching of 847 pairs, certified by a complete directed Hasse graph topological sort visiting all 1696 faces, and precisely critical dimensions 0 and 5. Forman theorem gives a CW complex with one 0 and one 5 cell, necessarily \(S^5\). Four-cycle edge incidence establishes all 16 automorphisms. Signed complete simplicial Lefschetz traces give r_*=s_*=-1 on integral H5. Averaging after subdivision yields reduced rational acyclicity of the \(D_8\) quotient. All computations were rerun on the delivered standard-library script; no infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The Wagner graph and the cube are the natural twisted/untwisted cubic eight-vertex ladders, and degree-two matching topological ranks discriminate them (W one \(S^5\), Q3 three \(S^5\)). The integral sign character adds symmetry information that a nonequivariant homotopy equivalence does not entail, and rational quotient acyclicity is a structural consequence. This is a complete exact natural finite object/invariant calculation, potentially relevant to longer twisted-ladder comparisons, rather than a routine numeric increment or arbitrarily chosen slice. Scope is finite and no generalized pattern is asserted.
